verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, so scoping what credentials or permissions a delegated agent receives is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows isolation features (dedicated worktrees, read-only preflight, private fresh repositories for benchmark candidates, local views without a mutation API), but nothing about issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens for agents. Isolation is not credential scoping, so it is not credited here.
